verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a public pricing/plans article exists and that the Lite tier is free for a single user, but no evidence shows exact per-seat dollar pricing or feature inclusions for paid tiers (Starter, Business, etc.), so a founder can't fully compare costs before contacting sales. Missing for 10: actual per-seat price points for paid tiers, feature-by-tier comparison table, and enterprise/sales-only pricing disclosure.
